description: Four small plastic plates—red, green, yellow, and blue—are laid out on a light green tablecloth near the right side of the table. The left hand reaches in from the right, picks up the blue plate and sets it down on top of the green plate, then slides the stack toward the yellow plate and nudges the yellow plate onto the pile; finally, the left hand moves the red plate onto the stack and releases, leaving all the plates neatly stacked together.
